title: Hunt for the Oldest DNA
description: I feature in Niobe Thompson’s documentary about the discovery of ancient DNA and a two-million-year-old ecosystem in Greenland.

title: The world’s oldest DNA: A window into Greenland’s past
description: At Arktisk Festival, I spoke about the DNA from Kap København and what it reveals about Greenland’s past plants, animals and climate.

title: Ancient DNA in Danube sediments
description: Giulia Zampirolo and I wrote a popular science article for Videnskab.dk about ancient DNA, past human activities and environmental change along the Danube.

title: Ask Me Anything with PBS NOVA
description: A public Reddit Q&A with PBS NOVA about the discovery of the world’s oldest DNA, accompanying Hunt for the Oldest DNA.

title: NPR / Short Wave
description: I contributed expert commentary on ancient squirrel droppings as archives of Ice Age DNA in NPR’s science news roundup on 11 June 2026.

title: Radio4: Missionen
description: I joined the programme “Vi sikrer artens overlevelse” on 29 March 2023, discussing species survival and biodiversity alongside other invited guests.

title: Jagten på den sidste dinosaur
description: I took part as the DNA researcher in this DR2 documentary series following an expedition to the Republic of the Congo with Christoffer Knuth.

title: Vin & Videnskab: Copenhagen’s underground history
description: At the Natural History Museum of Denmark’s event on 7 November 2018, I presented how sediment cores from the Botanical Garden reveal Copenhagen’s history through the City Core project.

title: Kultursalonerne Gisselfeld
description: Public talks about the stories preserved in DNA from mud and how DNA research can shed light on Gisselfeld’s history, bringing science into a festival of music, literature and ideas.
